scope: Time-series foundation models and zero-shot forecasters that could be dropped into backend/research/kronos_feature_ic.py as a forecast_batch(windows) class (512 five-minute OHLCV bars in, 12 closes out), for the L40 harness (docs/research/prereg-kronos-feature-ic.md).
channels_used: GitHub via authenticated gh CLI (repos, issues search, forks)
Hugging Face public model API via curl (metadata, raw READMEs)
r.jina.ai page reads (arXiv, blogs, docs); jina was rate-blocked for huggingface.co so raw READMEs were fetched directly
cost_benchmark_note: The sweep's 'Sharpe 6.44 gross to -3.62 at 20 bp' pair is quoted, with the same numbers, by the mental-momentum summary as a global long-short evaluation of a baseline model from the TSFM-in-finance literature (its ref 34), and that summary also relays from Rahimikia et al. 2511.18578 a from-scratch financial TimesFM-20M at Sharpe -1.87 under 11.2/21.3 bp mixed costs. I fetched the 138-page 2511.18578 PDF but the jina text extraction did not contain those figures (likely in tables/figures), so the pair is traced, not re-verified.
general_finding: No candidate has any independent out-of-sample evidence net of transaction costs on intraday stocks, Indian or otherwise. The only NSE cost-aware number is a negative one for pretrained Kronos-small at a daily horizon (kronos-nse-1d). Every finance paper found (2511.18578, 2606.27100) is daily, gross of costs, and null-to-negative.
harness_notes: All generic models instance-normalise on the context; on a near-random-walk price series the forecast is last value plus a learned drift, so the harness's partial IC given m60 (the last hour's return) is the control that matters.
Probabilistic models: use the median (quantile models) or sample mean (Sundial) as the harness's c_hat; fix seeds for Sundial exactly as the prereg fixes them for Kronos.
Guard flat windows: several models (TimesFM NaN issues, Lag-Llama #130) misbehave when a 512-bar window has zero variance.
Chronos family: install a build after 2026-09-08 (PR #532) or run in float32, because bf16 unscaling loses low-order bits at price levels of 1e3-1e5 with tick-scale variation.

candidates.name: Chronos-2
candidates.input_output: Encoder-only (T5-style) patch model. Univariate, multivariate and covariate-informed (past-only and known-future) in one checkpoint via group attention. Max context 8192. Multi-step quantile forecasts (any quantile levels). Point = median.
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes (120M; fp32 ~0.5 GB). Card: >300 forecasts/s on one A10G; CPU also supported.
known_bugs: Commit 6c69155 fixed past/future covariate separation in Chronos2Pipeline; issue #462 (2026-02-10, closed, no reply) asks whether the paper's multivariate results still hold. Covariate path only.

PR #532 (merged 2026-09-08): bf16 unscaling discarded low-order bits when the series level is large relative to its variation (max delta 252 at level 1e5, variation 100). Directly relevant to price-level inputs: install a build after 2026-09-08 or run in float32.
Open: #502 clip-to-context option, #537 predict_df ordering with categorical ids.
candidates.independent_evidence: 2606.27100 (daily US, 5 large caps, L=512, MAE vs random walk, no costs): Chronos v1 is one of only two model-stock cells with a one-sided DM p<0.05 (AMZN p=0.0421); Chronos-2 itself not significant anywhere. No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29).
candidates.sweep_2026_09_26_named_it: family only; the Kronos note §4 names Chronos via 2511.18578 (Chronos-large zero-shot R2 -1.37% on daily excess returns)
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Univariate on close (median of quantiles), 512-bar context, prediction_length=12. A second configuration with O/H/L/V as past covariates is a second feature and would enlarge the pre-registered family; decide before running. Use a source build after 2026-09-08 (PR #532) or torch float32.

candidates.name: TiRex-2
candidates.licence: Apache-2.0 (TiRex-2 card and HF tag); the original TiRex is under the NXAI Community License
candidates.params: 38.4M active univariate + 44.1M for multivariate (card); safetensors total not exposed by the API
candidates.input_output: Recurrent xLSTM patch model. Univariate and multivariate targets with past and future-known covariates in one checkpoint; quantile output; streaming (constant per-patch cost). Strictly causal over targets per the abstract. Predecessor's max prediction_length 2048 (#27).
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes (~83M total). sLSTM CUDA kernels need compute capability >= 8.0; RTX 3060 Ti is 8.6. CPU path exists (slower).
known_bugs: Predecessor issue #9 'Future tokens are not masked during inference' (closed 2025-07): clarified by the authors as a design property (one token predicted per 32-step patch; N-1 NaN tokens appended), not a leak.
Predecessor #22 'quantile_levels input ignored' (closed 2025-10); #27 undocumented 2048 max horizon (documented in FAQ).
candidates.independent_evidence: No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29). Its only finance-adjacent number is GIFT-Eval CRPS 0.4781 (5th) per The Forecasting Company's Sep-2026 table.
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Strongest cheap multivariate candidate: feed OHLCV as five variates, read the close variate's median at +3/+6/+12. Also run univariate close for comparability with the rest.

candidates.name: TimesFM-2.5
candidates.params: 231M safetensors (200M core + optional 30M continuous quantile head)
candidates.input_output: Decoder-only patch model, univariate only (covariates only via an external XReg ridge regression). Context up to 16k (README) / max_context param; horizon up to 1k with the quantile head; point + 10 quantiles; normalize_inputs=True.
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes (~0.9 GB fp32). Speed not reported by the card.
known_bugs: #338 (open, 2025-11-07): forecast_with_covariates() XReg leaks later batch items' context into earlier ones when series in a batch are time-ordered; maintainer confirmed, workaround batch_size=1; fix PR #393 (open, 2026-04-04). Covariate path only; the plain forecast() is unaffected.

NaN handling: #321 nan output, #381 NaN in autoregressive decode, #486 all-NaN interpolation, #507 zero-variance sqrt guard (all open) - a flat 512-bar window (illiquid stock, halt) can produce NaN; guard for it.
#506 MLX backend diverges from PyTorch (use PyTorch).
candidates.independent_evidence: 2606.27100 (daily US, no costs): TimesFM-2.5 has the best average rank with Moirai-2.0 but no DM-significant cell. 2511.18578 (daily excess returns, global): TimesFM 500M zero-shot R2 -2.80%; a 20M TimesFM pre-trained from scratch on financial data keeps a Sharpe of -1.87 under mixed 11.2/21.3 bp costs per the mental-momentum summary of that paper. All negative; none intraday.
candidates.sweep_2026_09_26_named_it: family only; Kronos note §4 names TimesFM via 2511.18578 and 2606.27100
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Univariate close, forecast(horizon=12). It is the most-tested TSFM in the finance literature and every test is null, so a null here is expected; a pass would be the surprise worth having.

candidates.name: Moirai 2.0 (R-small)
candidates.licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research only; the card says the proprietary version is used by Salesforce)
candidates.input_output: Decoder-only, quantile loss, patch tokens with missing-value info; univariate target with optional dynamic real covariates (feat_dynamic_real). Only the small size exists for 2.0. Context configurable.
known_bugs: #224 (open, 2025-08-12): Moirai2 accuracy drops significantly when feat_dynamic_real are present - do not pass OHLV as covariates.
#232 PackedQuantileMAELoss (training only). #249 'Update TiRex model URL to avoid leakage' concerns GIFT-Eval benchmark contamination, not inference.
candidates.independent_evidence: 2606.27100 (daily US, no costs): Moirai-2.0 has the strongest average rank and is DM-significant on GOOG (p=0.0421) only. No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29).
candidates.sweep_2026_09_26_named_it: family only; Kronos note §4 names Moirai-2.0 via 2606.27100
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Univariate close only (#224). NC licence: fine for the research harness, never for the live path.

candidates.name: Granite TimeSeries PatchTST-FM-r2
candidates.input_output: Univariate encoder (PatchTST + Conformer block), context 8192, overlapping patches 16/8, 99-quantile head; example uses context_length=512, prediction_length=64, quantile_levels.
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes (~1.5 GB fp32). Speed not reported.
known_bugs: None found (new model; no leakage issues in granite-tsfm search).
candidates.independent_evidence: Card: top permissive-licence zero-shot model on GIFT-Eval as of 2026-08-31 (CRPS 0.4672 per the t0-beta table). No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29).
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Univariate close; context 512 matches the harness exactly. Newest permissive general model; a good 'best generic univariate' control.

candidates.name: Sundial (base-128m)
candidates.input_output: Decoder-only generative model: samples trajectories (num_samples) rather than quantiles; univariate (#9 multivariate open); context up to 2880, patch 16, multi-patch prediction up to 720. Card: 2880->720 in 510 ms on A100 (one sample).
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes (~0.5 GB fp32). Requires transformers==4.40.1 per card; DynamicCache issue #5 with newer versions.
known_bugs: #5 'DynamicCache has no attribute get_max_length' (closed) - pin transformers. No leakage issues found; only 14 issues total.
candidates.independent_evidence: No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29).
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness
candidates.recommendation_detail: Same generative class as Kronos, so fix seeds and sample_count exactly as §2 of the prereg; use the sample mean at +3/+6/+12.

candidates.name: Toto 2.0 (313m / 22m)
candidates.input_output: Decoder-only patched transformer alternating causal time attention and full variate attention; native multivariate; quantiles 0.1..0.9 of shape (9, batch, n_variates, horizon); single-pass or block decoding; variable context. Trained on observability metrics plus public data. Requires Python 3.12+.
candidates.fits_8gb: Yes for 313m (1.25 GB fp32) and 22m; 1B borderline, 2.5B (9.1 GB fp32) no. Card: ~ms-scale forward pass for a 1024-step forecast on A100.
known_bugs: None found; issue tracker is dependency bumps. Fine-tuning and exogenous covariates not yet available for 2.0.
candidates.independent_evidence: No independent net-of-cost evidence on stocks found (searched Exa, GitHub, arXiv 2026-09-29). Leaderboard-only (BOOM, GIFT-Eval, TIME).
candidates.recommendation: test in the L40 harness (lower priority than TiRex-2 for the multivariate slot)
candidates.recommendation_detail: OHLCV as five variates, read the close variate's median. Observability pre-training is the furthest domain from prices of all candidates.
